test: A joint: each theme of the pair has concepts of its own kind in the sample, an act that does both included; the cut follows a seam the material shows. A lump: no sampled concept is purely one function; the scheme cuts one act by its words. Unresolved: pure forms of both exist, but a large share of the sample sits in a middle the scheme cuts by vocabulary alone. A joint or an unresolved pair is retained; a lump is merged under rule 10's arithmetic.

calls.evidence: Alarms and calls to fight a named attacker stand alone (archlinux t04 c0063 'raising the alarm that Sweden is attacking'; placeDE t03 c0030 'calling everyone to battle stations'), and so does upkeep with no attacker (placeDE t03's Putzkolonne c0069, c0288; dwarffortress t03 c0101 'correcting errant pixels'). Rooms run both as one practice of keeping the work standing.
calls.contrary: All 12 sampled second-order themes name defence and repair as one practice, and calls for hands against the same damage are placed either way by their wording (scotland t05 c0093 'calling people to fix current vandalism' in T3-021, c0154 'calling on brothers to defend' in T3-005; mindcrack t02 c0035 'maintaining Guude against multiple attackers' in T3-021). The boundary moved at B2 and split readers again; section 1 makes it a merge candidate.
calls.action: retain; the edge (a call for hands against damage) is the decide_when_both's 'when the attack and the fight lead'.

calls.evidence: Celebrating ('celebrating that we did it', 'announcing that Skelly is done') and thanking ('thanking everyone who worked on and defended the finished masterpiece') are different acts in the words of nearly every concept; end-of-event threads carry both.
calls.contrary: Mixed concepts celebrate and thank at once (scotland t06 c0090 'celebrating the phenomenal Saltire and thanking the lads' in T3-009), and the boundary moved at B2 (edits 22, 60).

calls.evidence: Pure forms exist: border geometry (colombia t03 c0071 'posting a plan for the Belgium-Colombia border') and peace ending a war (colombia t03 c0014 'offering to negotiate a peace treaty'). But most sampled items hold requests to spare a work or to coexist, which gates 15 to 21 cut by whether peace or a truce is named: gravityfalls t05 c0055 'asking the Gun God and Dream Demon to coexist' (T3-010) against c0049 'proposing a truce so both logos can live' (T3-149); forsen t03 c0040 'asking nicely not to draw over the goose' (T3-010) against c0006 'calling for truce with the Dino Face' (T3-149).
calls.contrary: A lump: the middle is one act, a request between neighbours not to harm each other's work, and the named-words line splits it by vocabulary; the coders bundle both in every sampled theme, and fresh readers swapped the pair at B4.
calls.action: retain; reported as the scheme's least drawn line in G14.

calls.evidence: A deal that trades room for help is one act with two terms (kamenrider t04 c0030 'offering to share the spot if Kamen Rider helps the Mariners'); pure border settlements (purdue t06's column 60 deals) and pure help-for-help offers (unturned t05 c0090 'offering protection in return for protection') both appear.
calls.contrary: Some bargains are placed under T3-010 only, their help terms uncounted (europe t03 c0288).

calls.evidence: Design (seahawks t07 c0060 'turning a 15 into a green 12') and spot (lsu t01 c0044 'choosing a spot that had gone untouched for hours') are separate decisions in most concepts; one planning act decides both when size is fitted to a place.
calls.contrary: Size-for-place concepts sit either side (nightinthewoods t02 c0027 'a smaller Gregg sprite beside the snoo' in T3-004; seahawks t07 c0062 'a very small 12 where blue and a one already exist' in T3-020).

calls.evidence: An opening call ('calling for making Jeb on r/place') both proposes the mark and calls hands: the same act performs both functions. Proposal-only concepts (onepunchman t01 c0002, design options while waiting) and recruitment-only concepts (enterthegungeon t01 c0022 'recruiting help to complete an already-started Bullet Kin') both exist.
calls.contrary: The same opening call is placed either way (onepunchman t01 c0047 'calling to get Saitama on r/place' in T3-002; unturned t03 c0019 'calling to get Unturned onto r/place' in T3-033); the cluster moved at B2 and split readers again.
calls.action: retain; the decide_when_both's 'mark already chosen' test is the edge.

calls.evidence: The room's own restraint said to its members (asktransgender t03 c0042 'trying not to destroy existing artwork'; PurplePixels t05 c0071 'We should not be attacking') differs from a deal made with a neighbour (geometrydash t08 c0057 'asking r/ainbowroad permission').
calls.contrary: Promises of restraint made to a neighbour sit either side (babymetal t05 c0132 'promising not to overwrite a neighbor's green design' in T3-024; c0172 'promising the smaller logo will not touch The Metal' in T3-010).

calls.evidence: Asking for help (russia t08 c0044 'asking Russian brothers to help Armenia') and giving it (placetardis t07 c0068 'sending spare pixels to the third tiny TARDIS') are different acts in the words.
calls.contrary: A relayed request for a third room is placed either way (hearthstone t14 c0287 'passing on r/overwatch's call' in T3-011; homestuck t15 c0198 'relaying Armenia's request' in T3-084).
